segments.text: welcome to the 11th edition of react weekly digest in this weekly Roundup we've handpicked popular react libraries
based on GitHub Trends save time and stay updated on the most exciting react content for your
projects fake glow material for react 3 fiber is a material designed to create a glow effect from a 3D mesh using glsl
shaders directly unlike traditional methods relying on post-processing effects this material offers improved performance
avoiding the usual drawbacks a react component that converts any image into interactive
particles this free npm package provides a react component for creating stunning visual effects turning images into
interactive particles that engage visitors and enhance the overall user experience react map is a collection of
interactive map components for react offering over 200 maps including countries and continents designed for ease of use with
a small dependency size it includes disputed territories to provide options without taking sides users are encouraged to report
issues for resolution react stacked toast is a lightweight react component that
provides stacked toast notification features with a small footprint of approximately 6 kilobytes when gzipped
it allows for easy customization of toast notifications by passing a react component according to your
preferences palety offers trending themes for websites accompanied by a playground for instant theme
previews supporting popular UI libraries like mui and shads anui pedify allows users to easily copy and paste beautiful
themes into their applications that concludes this week's react weekly digest stay tuned for more exciting
react libraries and projects happy coding
